suggestions.roleTitle: AI Visual Director & Brand Experience Specialist
suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên gia Định hướng Hình ảnh AI & Trải nghiệm Thương hiệu
suggestions.reasoning: As generative diffusion models automate basic banner creation and photo retouching (experiencing high exposure according to OpenAI/UPenn 2023), the market demand shifts heavily toward professionals who can steer AI pipelines with human aesthetic judgment. TopCV Vietnam (2024) reports a 68% rise in roles requiring AI visual direction with 30-50% higher salaries, compensating for the 42% contraction in junior 2D banner designer positions.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your background as a Graphic Designer with 2.5 years of experience, combined with your strong color and layout sensibilities, brand empathy, and keen eye for visual trends, makes you perfectly positioned to transition from manual asset production to high-level AI art direction. Instead of fearing automation, you can leverage your aesthetic intuition to direct tools like Midjourney and Adobe Firefly.
